query_text: 我想找一家不用等位、到店就能马上入座吃饭的餐厅，有这样的地方推荐吗？
requirement_text: 评论需说明顾客到店后是否无需等待即可立即入座。
evidence_context:
Both dishes were garnished with carrot flowers. 
The service was excellent. We were seated immediately  - just before 6:30. Our order was taken quickly, although we were given ample time to consider the menu. Food arrived within an entirely reasonable amount of time, and it was served hot. Water glasses were refilled, but not with such frequency as to be annoying. 
All in all, we had a lovely meal and a lovely evening.

query_text: 周末去吃饭最怕排长队等桌位，想找一家基本不需要长时间等位的餐厅。
requirement_text: 评论需能证明顾客无需长时间等待即可入座。
evidence_span: I've always been lucky enough to get seated without a long wait.
evidence_context: I've been here a few times and everything I've ordered has been amazing. The wait staff is charismatic and helpful, the food is delicious and authentic, and I've always been lucky enough to get seated without a long wait.

query_text: 想吃顿早饭但特别讨厌等位，能不能推荐一家等桌时间短的餐厅？
requirement_text: 评论需说明顾客为了等到餐桌实际等候了多长时间。
evidence_span: My husband and I waited over an hour for a table here
evidence_context:
Omg this is the best breakfast I've had in a long time. My husband and I waited over an hour for a table here, which we never ever do, and it was totally worth the wait! (Not in his opinion, but mine :) 

I am absolutely obsessed with the blue yogurt berry and granola bowl. This is by far the BEST yogurt bowl I've ever eaten!! See photos.. you'll be amazed. I have since dreamed about this yogurt multiple mornings for breakfast and sometimes am tempted just order it for delivery halfway across the city. 

We also had chicken and waffles which was pretty good, but not nearly as good as the short rib huevos rancheros, which to me looks more like quesadillas (see photos). This was also some of the best huevos rancheros I have ever had and the serving size was huge enough to feed two people!

query_text: 计划周六晚上订个餐厅聚餐，我最怕已经订了位还要在门口排队苦等，大家有什么经验？
requirement_text: 评论需说明顾客即使有预约，实际等位入座花了多长时间。
evidence_span: I wish I'd been better prepared to wait 35 minutes to be seated!
evidence_context:
I hope this was just a fluke - but I wish I'd been better prepared to wait 35 minutes to be seated! -even though my small party of two made a reservation for Saturday night.  We arrived right on time and saw that the waiting room was packed. There was no place to stand and wait, or grab a drink at the bar. After talking to a few couples around us, we realized we were not alone - and in for a long wait time. Some people had been waiting over an hour to be seated - understandably since they made no reservation. But we did! Yet we noticed on the hostess' screen that there were 7 other 9:30 dinner reservation parties also waiting to be seated!

Finally after 10 pm we were shown to our table. I have to say that our server noticed what had happened and he quickly remedied the situation the only way he could: by bringing our food and drinks out quickly!! The food was delicious as always.
